Verifies that:
Plugin initializes with enable_mmap_loading=true
Plugin is ready after initialization
Mmap path can be configured

briefdescription.para: OCP-MM-02: Mmap gracefully falls back to traditional loading.

detaileddescription.para:
Verifies that:
Plugin initializes even with invalid mmap path (graceful fallback)
Plugin is ready (using traditional loading)
No error is returned (fallback is silent)

briefdescription.para: OCP-MM-03: Mmap with invalid file path returns error with meaningful diagnostic.

detaileddescription.para:
Verifies that:
Plugin can detect path issues
Health check reflects the state

briefdescription.para: OCP-MM-04: Mmap with corrupted file handles error gracefully.

detaileddescription.para:
Verifies that:
Very small/corrupt files don't cause crashes
Plugin handles gracefully

briefdescription.para: OCP-MM-05: Mmap'd model produces identical embeddings vs traditional loading.

Verifies that:
Two plugins (one mmap'd, one traditional) produce identical embeddings
Deterministic seed ensures reproducibility

briefdescription.para: OCP-MM-06: Mmap'd model handles batch inference correctly.

Verifies that:
Batch inference works with mmap'd models

briefdescription.para: OCP-MM-07: Text embeddings work with mmap'd model.

Text embedding generation works with mmap'd models
